title: `os datasource introspect --out` path check is lexical: an in-tree symlink lets the server-generated draft land outside the project directory (hardening)
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibzj9DrVWXkq7joYHGB

Reproduction (a557fa38; scratch showcase copy served by `os dev` with an admin token holding manage_platform_settings; cwd = the app dir):
1. `mkdir -p /tmp/outside && ln -s /tmp/outside objects/lnk`
2. `os datasource introspect showcase_external --table orders --out objects/lnk/qa_sym.object.ts --url http://localhost:<port> --token <admin>`

Expected: the same refusal `--out ../x.ts` and `--out /tmp/x.ts` get ("--out must be a relative path within the current directory", exit 2, nothing written). The draft body is server-generated TypeScript, and the jail is meant to keep it inside the project tree.
Actual: exit 0, "Wrote objects/lnk/qa_sym.object.ts", and the file is created in /tmp/outside/, outside the project directory.

Mechanism: packages/cli/src/commands/datasource/introspect.ts:75-80 computes `target = resolve(process.cwd(), flags.out)` and checks `isAbsolute(flags.out) || !target.startsWith(process.cwd() + '/')`, then calls `writeFile(target, …)`. The check is purely lexical, so symlinks in the path are never resolved. Suggested hardening: realpath the target's parent directory (and cwd) before the in-tree prefix check, and refuse when the resolved parent is outside cwd. Optionally also refuse when the target itself is an existing symlink.

Severity: low. The operator supplies both the --out path and the directory tree, so no authn/authz, tenant or secret boundary is crossed (the seat ruled it not a security finding). It matters only when a project tree carries a symlink the operator did not plant, for example one committed in a cloned repo.

Regression: not new. The lines are identical at 181ad7d4 (18.4.0), and `git log 181ad7d4..HEAD -- packages/cli/src/commands/datasource/introspect.ts` is empty.

Dedupe (open issues, read-only `gh api search/issues`), no match: "datasource introspect --out symlink", "introspect out realpath", "--out must be a relative path within the current directory", "datasource introspect out path jail".

QA-source: #33829 · cli.datasource-introspect-codegen · observed beside the clauses
